```{r}
install.packages("ordinal")
library(ordinal)
library(MASS)
library(splines)
```


```{r}
df <- read.csv("swan_analysis_ready_v3.csv")

df$sleep_quality <- ordered(df$sleep_quality)
df$meno_stage <- factor(df$meno_stage, ordered = TRUE)
df$SWANID <- factor(df$SWANID)
df$RACE <- factor(df$RACE)
df$presc_med <- factor(df$presc_med, levels = c(0, 1),
                           labels = c("No", "Yes"))
df$VMS_binary <- as.integer(df$VMS_binary)
```

```{r}
df$INCOME <- factor(
  df$INCOME,
  levels = c(1,2,3,4),
  labels = c("<20k","20-49k","50-99k","100k+")
)
```



```{r}
#Complete model
##The controlled nAGQ was useful for the DHEAS model, keep it for consistency
model_clmm2_reduced_controlled_sp <- clmm(
  sleep_quality ~ AL_score_reduced + meno_stage + AGE_baseline + RACE + presc_med +
    INCOME + VMS_binary + ns(CESD_score, df = 3) + (1 | SWANID),
  data      = df,
  link      = "logit",
  Hess      = TRUE,
  nAGQ      = 10,
  control   = clmm.control(maxIter = 100, gradTol = 1e-4),
  na.action = na.omit
)

summary(model_clmm2_reduced_controlled_sp)

```

```{r}
summary(model_clmm2_reduced_controlled_sp)

```

```{r}
exp(coef(model_clmm2_reduced_controlled_sp)) #odds ratios
exp(confint(model_clmm2_reduced_controlled_sp)) #confidence intervals
```
```{r}
ci_reduced <- confint(model_clmm2_reduced_controlled_sp)

OR_table_reduced <- cbind(
  OR = exp(coef(model_clmm2_reduced_controlled_sp)),
  exp(ci_reduced)
)

OR_table_reduced
```




```{r}
model_clm2 <- clm(
  sleep_quality ~ AL_score_reduced + meno_stage + AGE_baseline + RACE + presc_med +
    INCOME + VMS_binary + CESD_score,
  data      = df,
  link      = "logit",
  na.action = na.omit
)

nominal_test(model_clm2)
```


```{r}
model_clm2_partial <- clm(
  sleep_quality ~ AL_score_reduced + meno_stage + AGE_baseline + RACE + presc_med +
    INCOME + VMS_binary + CESD_score,
  nominal   = ~ meno_stage + RACE + CESD_score + presc_med + 
                INCOME,
  data      = df,
  link      = "logit",
  na.action = na.omit
)

nominal_test(model_clm2_partial)
```


```{r}
cat("AL_score_reduced in constrained clm:    ", coef(model_clm2)["AL_score_reduced"], "\n")
cat("AL_score_reduced in partial clm:        ", coef(model_clm2_partial)["AL_score_reduced"], "\n")
cat("AL_score_reduced in primary clmm:       ", model_clmm2_reduced_controlled_sp$beta["AL_score_reduced"], "\n")
```


#Plot predicted probs
```{r}
newdat_al_reduced <- expand.grid(
  AL_score_reduced     = 0:4,
  meno_stage   = levels(df$meno_stage)[2],           # early peri as reference
  AGE_baseline = mean(df$AGE_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
  RACE         = levels(df$RACE)[1],
  presc_med    = "No",
  INCOME       = "20-49k",
  VMS_binary   = 0,
  CESD_score   = mean(df$CESD_score, na.rm = TRUE)
)


pred_al <- predict(model_clm2, newdata = newdat_al_reduced, type = "prob")
pred_df <- cbind(newdat_al_reduced, as.data.frame(pred_al$fit))

pred_long <- pivot_longer(pred_df,
                          cols      = c("1","2","3","4"),
                          names_to  = "sleep_quality",
                          values_to = "probability")


poor_sleep_df <- pred_long %>%
  mutate(sleep_quality = as.numeric(sleep_quality)) %>%
  group_by(AL_score_reduced) %>%
  summarise(
    poor_sleep_probability = sum(probability[sleep_quality %in% c(3, 4)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


theme_thesis <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, colour = "grey35"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggplot(poor_sleep_df, aes(x = AL_score_reduced, y = poor_sleep_probability)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, colour = "#2C3E50") +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, colour = "#2C3E50") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Reduced longitudinal allostatic load score",
    y = "Predicted probability",
    title = "Predicted probability of poorer sleep quality",
    subtitle = "Poorer sleep defined as sleep quality categories 3–4"
  ) +
  theme_thesis

```



```{r}
pred <- ggpredict(
  model_clmm2_reduced_controlled_sp,
  terms = "AL_score_reduced"
)

plot(pred)
```
